description: Unauthorized WebSocket API Access The WebSocket API routes ($connect, $disconnect, $default, sendMessage) are configured with 'NONE' as the authorizationType, allowing any client to establish a connection without authentication. An attacker could create an unauthorized WebSocket connection to intercept conversations, inject malicious messages, or perform reconnaissance on the system.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1213 - Data from Information Repositories
recommendation: Implement Cognito-based authentication for WebSocket connections
recommendation: Implement connection validation and session management

description: Insufficient Data Encryption at Rest While services use AWS-managed keys by default, the lack of customer-managed KMS keys means the organization doesn't have full control over the encryption lifecycle and key rotation. An attacker with access to AWS service APIs could potentially access encrypted data if they gain IAM credentials, as the default service-managed keys might not provide sufficient isolation.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Implement customer-managed KMS keys for all data storage services
recommendation: Enable encryption of Lambda environment variables
